data.name: Abbas
data.gender_notes: Abbas is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ع-ب-س (ʿ-b-s), 'to frown, be stern'; ʿAbbās also denotes a lion. Its root is ع-ب-س (ʿ-b-s). Borne by al-ʿAbbās ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib, uncle of the Prophet ﷺ. Abbas is a Arabic name meaning “Lion; stern; frowning”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Abbas expresses “Lion; stern; frowning”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ع-ب-س (ʿ-b-s), 'to frown, be stern'; ʿAbbās also denotes a lion.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abbas total 7, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
